# mcp/tests/fixtures/l109_tool_answers/knowledge_read_largest.json

## Governing Overview

[Owning route overview](../../overview.md)

## Purpose

Retain the largest knowledge_read answer-table sample as a static transport-shape witness.

## Code Commentary

The literal knowledge answer contains names, state/currentness qualifiers, locations and page/snapshot identity. An unmeasured code tree is recorded as unverifiable rather than current; the largest page retains its snapshot-bound continuation. It is not a live native-reader receipt.

The answer-table tests consume these exact fixture bytes. Production versus recorded provenance and regeneration belong to PROVENANCE.md and the test producer, not manual edits of identities, tokens or output counts. No secret or current operational credential is represented by these static values.

- This static answer records the naming/compact fields and its own epoch qualifiers. [1]
